title: DEVSMP
description: THE pack used on the DEVSMP server
body:
![Spawn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9c5b012cc323225c01a894e5ca1c3fa3ec61bdc.jpeg)



✨ **The DEVSMP Modpack** ✨ provides a mix of **optimization**, **tweaks**, and **visual enhancements** to make the game more beautiful overall. While it may not outperform the most popular optimization modpacks, it runs **perfectly** on our SMP server—offering a smooth multiplayer experience while still keeping that **classic Vanilla feel!** 🌿🎮  

⚙️ **Built for DEVSMP** ⚙️  
This modpack is designed with **our server in mind**, but you can use it as a **baseline** for your own! Feel free to **add or remove** mods to suit your preferences. However, we **only** take recommendations from DEVSMP players to add to the official releases.  

💡 **Need Help?** 💡  
If you're having trouble adding your own mods to this pack, I can try to help! 🛠️ [**Join the Discord**](https://discord.gg/qUxunKMSFq) and contact **Timothy** for assistance.  

📅 **Updates & Compatibility** 📅  
This modpack updates **only when our server does**. We usually switch to the newest **Minecraft update** as soon as it’s available, so it shouldn’t take long! ⏳ However, if you always want to play on the **latest version**, you can **copy the instance in the Modrinth app** and manually update **Fabric** yourself. 🔄  

Happy crafting! 🏗️🔥

![Divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/42a79c223e785e356a4053ef102694f80df55588.png)

**HOW TO INSTALL:**
1. Download the Modrinth app
2. Search for DEVSMP and click install
3. Run the instance, check your settings / keybinds and have fun!

![Divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/42a79c223e785e356a4053ef102694f80df55588.png)
